item.tib: snyan brgyud kyi sngon 'gro'i rim pa rnams
snyan brgyud kyi sngon 'gro rim pa rnams
item.coloph: de ltar man ngag yang snying rdzogs chen dgongs pa'i bcud/ zab dril snyan brgyud (rgyud) don gyi gdams pa la/ 'jug pa lam gyi sngon 'gro'i lag len rnams/ brtson sbyar nye bar bkod pa'i bsod nams ni/ 'gro kun don phyir g.yung drung sa la bsngo / snod ldan myong rtogs grol ba thob gyur cig rdzogs pa chen po snyan brgyud (rgyud) kyi rgyud dag cing sbyong bar byed pa sngon 'gro'i rim pa'o//
